name: Commander
description: Once per long rest, this Pokémon may use its action to leap into the mouth of a nearby Dondozo. While in the mouth, this Pokémon may not take actions that target creatures or objects outside of Dondozo's body; additionally, it cannot itself be targeted. While in the mouth, the Dondozo gains proficiency to WIS saves. This Pokémon may use an action to leave Dondozo's mouth, or it is ejected from the mouth at an adjacent space if Dondozo faints.
